{{Quote|What is a ''droid'', Dooku, but a clone by a different name? ''Built'', not grown&hellip; but both merely programmed ''tools''. Such tools can be twisted to better suit my purpose. You have your orders&hellip; and so will ''they''.|Darth Sidious|<ref name="The Only Good Clanker" />}}
'''Order 99''' was a directive for the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was issued during a [[Battle of Bogoa|battle]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bogoa]] to the [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] [[Coppertop]] by [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], on the orders of [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], who sought to test the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid's]] ability to change allegiances as a precursor to the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] own [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]].
